context: Yumiko and Sho tidy the kitchen.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (借り/置か/住む/流し/我が) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お皿を、流しに置いてくれる?
lines.en: Can you put the dishes in the sink?
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!流しがいっぱいだね。
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: コップは、棚に置いておいてね。
lines.en: Put the cups on the shelf.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 隣に住む子に、本を借りたんだ。
lines.en: I borrowed a book from the kid living next door.
lines.style: happy small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 借りた本は、大事にしてね。
lines.en: Take care of the borrowed book.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 我が家、きれいになったね!
lines.style: proud small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 流しを拭いたら、おしまいよ。
lines.en: Wipe the sink and we're done.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 本を、ちゃんと棚に置いたよ!
lines.en: I put the book on the shelf properly!
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
